 Appearance:

 Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Rajendra Singh Yadav - Public Prosecutor for the

 Order

This third repeat application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.464/2023 registered at Police Station Inderganj, District Gwalior (M.P.), for offence punishable under Sections 420, 419, 467, 468, 471 of IPC and afterward added Section 34 of IPC.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 28.03.2024.
His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 12.04.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.14420/2024.
His second bail application was also dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 20.05.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.20188/2024.

As per the case of prosecution, a written complaint was submitted with S.H.O., Police Station I n d e r g a n j , d i s t r i c t G w a l i o r o n t h e i n s t r u c t i o n o f N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N N O .

2024:MPHC-GWL:15798 2 MCRC-30015-2024 learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Gwalior,
interalia alleging that Munnalal, S/o Babulal has submitted forged documents for bail bond of Ahavaran Singh Yadav in RCT No.2999/2022.

Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Gwalior,
interalia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Matter was enquired.
It was found that the Bhu Adhikar Avam Rin Pustika submitted by Munnalal to secure bail for applicant-Ahavran Singh Yadav is forged.
Munnalal is not Bhumiswami of the land mentioned in the Bhu Adhikar and Rin Pustika .

Accordingly, Police Station Inderganj registered the F.I.R. at Crime No.464/2023 for the offence Ahavaran Singh Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34246402/
1 punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC against Munnalal and applicant Ahavaran..

sentences.text: After investigation, applicant-Ahavaran Singh Yadav was rrested on 28.03.2024.
He is in custody ever since.
On completion of investigation, final report was submitted.

The learned counsel for the applicant in addition to the ground mentioned in the application has submitted that the applicant is implicated merely for the reason that Munnalal had stood surety for him.
Applicant was not aware about the forgery of Bhu Adhikar and Rin Pustika by Munnalal.
The matter relates to bail bond and surety for Rs.5,000/-
Applicant has already undergone custody for about six months.
Learned trial Court has exonerated the applicant from other offence and charged him for the offence punishable under Sections 420/34 and Section 471 read with Section 34 of IPC.
The conclusion of trial will take time.
Except the pending matter, there is no criminal antecedent against the applicant.
Applicant is aged about 50 years.
He is an agriculturist.
He is the sole bread earner of the family.
There is no likelihood of absconsion leaving his family and home.
There is no NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15798 3 MCRC-30015-2024 likelihood of tampering with evidence by applicant.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
